Hero.header: CV Builder to help you land your dream job
Hero.subtitle: Choose a professional template, fill in your details, and download your ready-made CV for free. No login or hidden fees required.

TemplatesSection.subtitle: Free, readable, and tailored to your industry.

FeaturesSection.header: Tailor your CV to your needs
FeaturesSection.subtitle: Full control over the document's appearance.

card1.text: Create a free account to store up to 5 different CV versions and access them from any device.

card2.text: Download a ready-made high-quality A4 document that passes through recruitment systems (ATS) without issues.

card3.text: Change font size, line spacing, and margins to fit everything on one page.

card4.text: Add custom categories like "Projects" or "Volunteering". Change their order with a single move.

StepsSection.subtitle: Our builder will guide you through the entire process.

card1.text: Browse free designs and pick one that suits your industry.

card2.text: Enter your data, add custom sections, and adjust font size. You have full control over the layout.

card3.text: Save the finished CV to your drive and send it to the employer.

Footer.text: The best free online CV builder

Privacy.title: Privacy Policy
Privacy.section1Text: The administrator of personal data in the <bold>{appName}</bold> service is <bold>{creatorName}</bold> based in {address}, e-mail: <mailStyle>{email}</mailStyle>.
Privacy.section2Text: We process data that you voluntarily enter into forms to generate a CV:
Privacy.section2Item1: <bold>Identification data:</bold> first name, last name, date of birth.
Privacy.section2Item2: <bold>Contact details:</bold> e-mail address, phone number, links to social profiles.
Privacy.section2Item3: <bold>Image:</bold> profile picture (avatar) uploaded to the service.
Privacy.section2Item4: <bold>Professional data:</bold> employment history, education, skills, certificates.
Privacy.section3Text: Your data is stored with trusted cloud infrastructure providers: <bold>Supabase</bold> (Database and File Storage) and <bold>Vercel</bold> (App Hosting). All data is secured and processed in accordance with applicable security standards and GDPR regulations.
Privacy.section4Text: The user has the <bold>"right to be forgotten"</bold>. You can delete your CV or your entire account at any time from the user panel, which results in irreversible deletion of data from our databases and file storage.
Privacy.section5Text: If you have any questions regarding the processing of personal data, please contact us at: <mailStyle>{email}</mailStyle>.

Terms.title: Terms of Service

Terms.section2Text: The service provides online tools for self-creation, editing, and generation of application documents (CVs). The service includes temporary storage of entered data and generation of preview files and final documents.
Terms.section3Text: As an administrator, I make every effort to ensure the service works correctly, however, please note that:
Terms.section3Item1: The service is a support tool — I do not guarantee employment or an invitation to a job interview.
Terms.section3Item2: The user bears full responsibility for the truthfulness and correctness of data entered into the document.
Terms.section3Item3: I am not responsible for service interruptions resulting from failures of external providers (e.g., Vercel, Supabase).
Terms.section4Text: All graphic templates, layout, and source code of the application are my property. The user is granted the right to use CV documents generated by themselves for purposes related to job seeking.
Terms.section5Text: Please direct any comments, errors, or complaints regarding the application's operation to the e-mail address: <mailStyle>{email}</mailStyle>.
